_doc: Progress (M12). milestones: population thresholds (owner: milestones are POPULATION) — each pays a chest of gold and goods into the keep and a landmark to place. achievements: special firsts, kept in the browser and carried over to every world. Research and tiers are wired (js/sim/unlock.js) but OFF: unlockEverything is true until the owner turns gating on.
